summary: Not approved. Part 10 covers Jinshu 109 units s0111–s0112 and s0262–s0296: the park-oxen share rule and Feng Yu’s long remonstrance with historical exempla (漢祖, 明/章, 先王 Murong Hui, 西伯, 石季龍, 堯/湯, 西門/史起) and the Wang Xian–Liu Ming–Song Gai counsel episode. Jinshu never years this block; ZZTJ 卷097 places the levy and remonstrance in 永和元年 (AD 345). Every owned AD 342 point year/hint under synthetic 咸康七年後明年及隨後紀事 is incorrect, and Wang Xian/Liu Ming are 前者 even relative to that speech. Supported: Han Gaozu BC 202–195 as a reign uncertainty window; Ming AD 57–75 and Zhang AD 75–88 inside 明、章之際; Yao/Tang as legendary antiquity. Incorrect inventions: Hui 307–333 career window, 西伯 BC 1100–1050, Shi Hu 334–349 reign window from a taunt, Ximen point BC 400, Shi Qi BC 350–300. No birth or age is stated in the owned units; no death is narrated here. English supplement: s0273 十有四 misread as fourteen-in-ten; s0282 鄭白 treated as a person. This is not a full-chapter approval.
